title: Moai
body:
"Home of Easter Island. Kinda sus though"

The Moai is a decorative object that can be purchased from Fungi Finds for $12,000.

Details

The Moai, like many items at Fungi Finds, has randomly generated qualities. Moais have a chance to spawn with a different colored nose. There is also a much smaller, independently rolled chance (1/100) that the Moai also comes with eyes and angry eyebrows. These features only appear after the Moai is purchased.
